name: dsh-plugins-cloud
install:
export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"
[ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
nvm install 22.22.2
nvm alias default 22.22.2
nvm use --delete-prefix 22.22.2 --silent || nvm use 22.22.2
hash -r
export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/v22.22.2/bin:$PATH"
node -v
corepack enable
corepack prepare pnpm@11.21.0 --activate
pnpm -v
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2
mkdir -p "$HOME/.dsh-cloud"
for name in dsh-hub-oauth-gateway dsh-coding-subscription-oauth dsh-coding-remote-kit; do
  for base in /workspace /agent/repos; do
    if [ -f "$base/$name/pnpm-lock.yaml" ]; then
      (cd "$base/$name" && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile)
    fi
  done
done
if [ -f ./pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; fi
dsh --version
